function.name: get_cookie_management_overview
function.description: Unavailable: this tool is not implemented and must not be called. Get a read-only overview of the current site's Cookie Management configuration and consent statistics.

startDate.description: Optional start date for consent statistics (inclusive). Format: yyyy-MM-dd

endDate.description: Optional end date for consent statistics (inclusive). Format: yyyy-MM-dd

includeDefinitions.description: Whether to include configured cookie definitions in the response. Default: true
